anomalies.description: A large crowd confronts a line of riot police with shields and helmets; sustained pushing, shoving, and physical clashes occur repeatedly across multiple frames, including individuals being forced to the ground and officers advancing in formation.

verification.reason: The visible sequence from f2 (2.0 s) through f25 (18.5 s) shows continuous collective violent unrest: dense crowd pressing against police line (f3–f6), people falling while resisting (f6–f8), coordinated police advance with batons/shields (f10–f13, f16–f17), and ongoing standoff with raised flags and active resistance (f20–f25). All candidate intervals [2.0–7.5], [4.0–11.5], [8.0–15.5], [12.0–19.5] are fully contained within this uninterrupted event. Merged due to shared context, participants, and temporal continuity.

anomalies.description: Discrete episodes of mutual physical combat between individuals in the crowd and police officers, including grappling, punching, baton use, and takedowns during close-quarters engagement.

verification.reason: Visible bilateral combat: f7 shows a person on ground actively resisting while multiple officers engage hands-on; f10 shows an officer swinging a baton while civilians push back and grapple; f13–f14 show direct hand-to-hand struggle with reciprocal force. These are distinct fighting episodes embedded within the broader riot. Candidates 2 (6.0–8.0), 5 (8.7–10.8), and 8 (13.5–15.0) all fall within 6.0–15.5 and are supported by evidence. Candidate 9 is excluded (see rejected).
